prompt: Create a high-quality polished anime portrait of Kashima from Kantai Collection, shown from upper thighs to head on a clean pure white background, centered and slightly tilted with a cheerful, elegant pose. She is a young woman with very pale silver-white long voluminous twin-tail hair, soft loose curls, airy layered bangs partly covering her forehead, and bright blue eyes with glossy highlights. Her expression is sweet and inviting: open smiling mouth, faint blush on both cheeks, relaxed eyebrows, and direct eye contact. She wears a navy sailor-style beret tilted back on her head, decorated on the right side with exactly 2 visible ribbon ornaments: 1 red-and-white checkered vertical ribbon and 1 red-and-yellow striped bow. Her outfit is an ornate white naval academy uniform with dark navy piping, a gray high collar shirt, a red neck ribbon tied at the throat, gold shoulder epaulettes on both shoulders, flared cuffs with gray ruffles, and a fitted double-breasted jacket. Include exactly 6 visible dark round front buttons on the jacket, 2 small dark pocket trims near the waist, 2 anchor-like navy decorations near the lower front hem, and a gray pleated skirt edge with navy and red trim partly visible at the bottom. Pose details: her left hand is raised beside her hair with delicate fingers near the shoulder, while her right hand rests confidently on her hip. Use crisp clean line art, luminous cel-shaded anime rendering, soft gradients, delicate hair strands, subtle fabric folds, refined highlights, and a bright minimal studio look. Keep the composition vertical, close-up, cute, elegant, and highly detailed, with no text, no watermark, and no background objects.
